# AtlasLaunch developer feedback — dev-01

Follow [the developer testing guide](../DEVELOPER_TEST.md), then fill in this form yourself. Save your completed copy as `feedback-dev-01.md` and return it privately to Paul with `atlaslaunch-dev-01.json`. Keep this repository template blank.

Do not include API keys or sensitive prompts. Record failures and help received honestly. Leave quality judgments blank for languages you cannot assess.
